item.title: Fear and Humiliation at Nvidia, and Why Google Bought Spirit Airlines Data
item.description:
Plus, the Friday news quiz.

Here’s what we’re covering:

  • Threats, Insults, Settlements: How Jensen Huang Made Humiliation Routine, by Emily Steel, Kalley Huang, Ryan Mac and Tripp Mickle
  • Nvidia Asked to Sell Chips to Companies Tied to Chinese Military and Megaspeed, by Ana Swanson and Cecilia Kang
  • Myanmar Committed Genocide Against the Rohingya, Top Global Court Finds, by Jeanna Smialek and Hannah Beech
  • Google Buys Worker Data From Spirit Airlines in a New Market to Feed A.I., by Rebecca Davis O’Brien

  • That ‘S.N.L.’ Sketch About Sister? It’s More Like Nonfiction., by Claire Cain Miller

    Listen to the end of the episode for an audio news quiz. If you want to take The Times’s weekly online news quiz, go here.

Tune in every weekday morning, and tell us what you think at: theheadlines@nytimes.com.
